County Council Report
notes: Mary Lloyd, County Councillor Ward 5 provided an overview of the ongoing County road, bridge and culvert projects, upgrades at the Elora transfer station, assessed policing cost of $430.29 per residence, social housing activities, the addition of an e-bike at Wellington Terrace, museum activities, Ridewell usage and upcoming Remembrance Day ceremonies.

items.title: Nadia Marquez Pabst, Vice President, Policy & Regulatory Affairs, Aypa
notes: Power provided an update on Aypa Power’s Elora Battery Energy Storage System (BESS) Project they are exploring as a part of The Independent Electricity System Operator's Long-term 1 Request for Proposals to expand Ontario’s grid capacity over the course of the decade. She explained Aypa Power would like Council to consider issuing a Municipal Support Resolution (MSR) for Aypa Power to include as a part of its bid submission which represents a sizable portion of points. The MSR is to acknowledge support from Centre Wellington to host the project in principle and does not supersede zoning by-laws or environmental assessments. N. Marquez Pabst noted it is important to note this request is time sensitive as the bid submission deadline is December 12, 2023.

Nadia Marquez Pabst and Ondrej Benjik responded to questions regarding the potential strain on volunteer fire departments and emergency protocols, compliance with the Canada Environmental Act, engagement with the indigenous community, use of water reservoirs, potential job creation, partnership with the community foundation, visual screening, battery disposal and recycling, land requirements, taxation and rehabilitation.

motions.item_title: Report from the Committee of the Whole – October 16, 2023
motions.text: THAT the Council of the Township of Centre Wellington approve the report from the Committee of the Whole dated October 16, 2023 as follows. 1. THAT the Council of the Township of Centre Wellington receive report IS2023-27 regarding the implementation of the Memorandum of Understanding required as part of the Conservation Authority Act, between the Township and with the Grand River Conservation Authority; AND THAT Council approves entering into said Memorandum of Understanding and delegates authority to sign the Memorandum of Understanding to the Mayor and Clerk. 2. THAT the Council of the Township of Centre Wellington direct staff to include the 2024 Preliminary Draft Capital Budget and the Preliminary Draft Bridge and Major Culverts 10 Year Plan, as outlined in report COR2023-87 dated October 16, 2023, in the 2024 Draft Budget. 3. THAT the Council of the Township of Centre Wellington direct staff to use the existing OLG Funding Allocation Policy, as outlined in By-law 2023-02 for 2024 Budget purposes, with the policy to be reviewed as part of the 2025 Budget process. 4. THAT the Council of the Township of Centre Wellington direct staff to include the 2024 staff initiatives outlined in report CAO2023-11 in the Draft 2024 Business Plan. AND THAT any changes made to the 2024 staff initiatives be tracked and presented to Council during 2024 Budget deliberations. 5. THAT the Council of the Township of Centre Wellington receives for information Report No. IS2023-25 St. David Street North Reconstruction Project Update. AND THAT Council endorses the implementation of a new controlled pedestrian crossing of St. David Street North at St. George Street, which will be constructed with the St. David Street Reconstruction Project. 6. THAT the Council of the Township of Centre Wellington authorizes Township Staff to undertake a pilot program to implement 40 kilometer per hour posted speed limits in an urban neighborhood in Centre Wellington, and report back to Township Council with findings and recommendations. AND THAT Council authorizes Township Staff to begin a community consultation program on 40 kilometer per hour posted speed limit neighborhoods. 7. THAT the Council of the Township of Centre Wellington authorize the Mayor and Municipal Clerk to execute a by-law to delegate certain powers and duties. 8. THAT the Council of the Township of Centre Wellington repeal By-law 2007- 021, being a By-law to Designate the Township of Centre Wellington as an Area Subject to Demolition Control in Accordance with Section 33 of the Planning Act R.S.O. 1990.

THAT the Council of the Township of Centre Wellington direct staff to include the 2024 Preliminary Draft Capital Budget and the Preliminary Draft Bridge and Major Culverts 10 Year Plan, as outlined in report COR2023-87 dated October 16, 2023, in the 2024 Draft Budget. 3. THAT the Council of the Township of Centre Wellington direct staff to use the existing OLG Funding Allocation Policy, as outlined in By-law 2023-02 for 2024 Budget purposes, with the policy to be reviewed as part of the 2025 Budget process. 4. THAT the Council of the Township of Centre Wellington direct staff to include the 2024 staff initiatives outlined in report CAO2023-11 in the Draft 2024 Business Plan. AND THAT any changes made to the 2024 staff initiatives be tracked and presented to Council during 2024 Budget deliberations. 5. THAT the Council of the Township of Centre Wellington receives for information Report No. IS2023-25 St. David Street North Reconstruction Project Update. AND THAT Council endorses the implementation of a new controlled pedestrian crossing of St. David Street North at St. George Street, which will be constructed with the St. David Street Reconstruction Project. 6. THAT the Council of the Township of Centre Wellington authorizes Township Staff to undertake a pilot program to implement 40 kilometer per hour posted speed limits in an urban neighborhood in Centre Wellington, and report back to Township Council with findings and recommendations. AND THAT Council authorizes Township Staff to begin a community consultation program on 40 kilometer per hour posted speed limit neighborhoods. 7. THAT the Council of the Township of Centre Wellington authorize the Mayor and Municipal Clerk to execute a by-law to delegate certain powers and duties. 8. THAT the Council of the Township of Centre Wellington repeal By-law 2007- 021, being a By-law to Designate the Township of Centre Wellington as an Area Subject to Demolition Control in Accordance with Section 33 of the Planning Act R.S.O. 1990.
